retake_if_failed: There is no single final exam; in case of failure — summer/repeat courses at school. University tests — once a year.
external_candidate: Yes: Alternative Learning System (ALS) Accreditation & Equivalency Test for school dropouts/adults.
note: The school diploma is not retaken; university tests — each university has its own rules (UPCAT — only once in a lifetime).

entrance_exam: University entrance exams (valintakoe) — an alternative route; main admission by ylioppilastutkinto points
retake_if_failed: Yes: a failed exam can be retaken 3 times in the next three sessions (spring/autumn); after obtaining the certificate — without limit.
external_candidate: Only upon enrolment in a lukio (including a distance/adult lyceum); there is no fully external candidate.
note: Since 2019 passed exams can be retaken without limit for improvement, the best result counts; sessions in spring and autumn.

retake_if_failed: At 8–10/20 — oral de rattrapage; on failure — repeating terminale or sitting as a candidat libre the following summer; grades ≥10 can be kept for 5 years.
external_candidate: Yes: candidat libre (register in autumn, take all the final exams).
note: A passed bac cannot be retaken to improve it; Parcoursup uses school grades, not only the final bac result.

certificate: Svjedodžba o državnoj maturi (Državna matura) + svjedodžba gimnazije
retake_if_failed: A failed subject — retake in the autumn session (jesenski rok) of the same year or in following years.
external_candidate: Only persons with completed 4-year secondary education may sit it (including from past years, graduates of vocational schools); without school — no (adult education first).
note: Matura exams can be retaken in subsequent years to raise scores for admission (annually, spring/autumn).

certificate: Diploma o položenom maturskom ispitu (matura, gimnazija)
retake_if_failed: A failed exam can be retaken in the next session (August) — details in the Pravilnik o maturskom ispitu; exact limits not confirmed.
external_candidate: Yes, as a vanredni učenik (external candidate) — not verified, not confirmed.
note: The possibility of a retake to improve the grade is not confirmed by the sources.

entrance_exam: University entrance exams (e.g. SCIO NSZ) — each university has its own
retake_if_failed: Two retakes (opravné zkoušky) of each failed part within 5 years (spring/autumn sessions).
external_candidate: No — only after finishing school (incl. correspondence/evening forms for adults).
note: A passed maturita cannot be improved; one can only retake university entrance tests (SCIO NSZ — multiple times, the best counts).

entrance_exam: PAES (DEMRE)
retake_if_failed: There is no final exam; PAES — 2 times a year (winter in June, regular in November–December), can be taken every year.
external_candidate: Yes: exámenes libres / validación de estudios for adults; the winter PAES only for graduates.
note: PAES twice a year; scores of the two latest admission processes are valid, the best valid score is used.

retake_if_failed: In case of failure — a single repetition (repeating the last year and the exams).
external_candidate: Yes: Schweizerische Maturitätsprüfung (SMK/SBFI) for private candidates.
note: A passed matura cannot be improved; after a failure — one retake.

entrance_exam: Högskoleprovet (optional, alternative queue)
retake_if_failed: No final exam; failed courses are taken through prövning or Komvux.
external_candidate: Yes: prövning (course exam) at Komvux for adults and external candidates.
note: Course grades can be raised via prövning/Komvux; högskoleprovet — 2 times a year, the best result is valid for 8 years.

certificate: GCE Advanced Level (Sri Lanka, Department of Examinations)
retake_if_failed: Annually; for admission to state universities — a maximum of 3 attempts.
external_candidate: Yes: private candidates after O/L.
note: Up to 3 attempts for admission to state universities (Z-score); retakes beyond that are not counted.

entrance_exam: EAES — Examen de Acceso a la Educación Superior (SENESCYT) / universities' own exams
retake_if_failed: Final exam (examen de grado) — if failed, a retake (supletorio); EAES — several times a year.
external_candidate: Yes: exámenes de validación / bachillerato intensivo for adults.
note: The entrance exam can be retaken in every admission period; the way results are counted is not confirmed.

retake_if_failed: A failed state exam can be retaken in following years (spring session).
external_candidate: Through an evening/correspondence gymnasium (täiskasvanute gümnaasium).
note: State exams can be retaken in subsequent years to improve the result (the detail "the best one counts" is not confirmed).

certificate: National Senior Certificate (NSC, matric) with admission to a bachelor's degree (Bachelor pass)
entrance_exam: NBT (National Benchmark Tests) — required by some universities
retake_if_failed: Supplementary/May–June exams; Second Chance Matric Programme — free retaking of subjects.
external_candidate: Yes: partial/external candidates; for 21+ — Amended Senior Certificate.
note: Subjects can be retaken for improvement via Second Chance; the best result counts.

entrance_exam: 수능 CSAT (College Scholastic Ability Test)
retake_if_failed: CSAT once a year (November), unlimited attempts (재수).
external_candidate: Yes: 검정고시 (GED exam) for those who did not finish school, then CSAT.
note: The CSAT can be taken annually without limit; the current year's result is used.

certificate: 高等学校卒業証書 (Kōtō gakkō sotsugyō shōmeisho)
entrance_exam: 大学入学共通テスト (Common Test) + university exams
retake_if_failed: Common Test once a year (January), unlimited (浪人).
external_candidate: Yes: 高卒認定試験 (twice a year) for those who did not finish school.
note: Common Test annually without restrictions; the current year's result is used.
